temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.explanation: NumPy can average an array of temperatures in one fast operation.

humidity.label: Humidity
humidity.explanation: NumPy can find the middle humidity value after sorting the array.

rainfall.label: Rainfall
rainfall.explanation: NumPy can quickly identify the wettest day in the range.

wind.label: Wind Speed
wind.explanation: NumPy can measure how much wind speed varies across the period.

concepts.name: Lists
concepts.description: Lists hold the daily weather values before they are converted into NumPy arrays.

concepts.name: Dictionaries
concepts.description: Dictionaries store the final metric names, units, and output fields.

concepts.name: Tuples
concepts.description: Tuples keep small, fixed pairs such as a metric label and its unit.

concepts.name: Sets
concepts.description: Sets help remove duplicate weather conditions when building summaries.

concepts.name: Loops
concepts.description: Loops walk through every record to prepare data for the calculations.

concepts.name: Functions
concepts.description: Functions package the repeated NumPy calculations into a reusable block.

concepts.name: Conditionals
concepts.description: Conditionals decide which weather bucket a record belongs to when counting conditions.
